description: Use when evaluating a vendor switch or building a competitive RFP against an incumbent. Returns alternative vendors with migration complexity scores, estimated savings, and switching narrative. Example: Salesforce alternatives — HubSpot at 22% lower median spend with comparable CRM coverage, Pipedrive at 41% lower for sales-only — migration complexity rated MEDIUM for both. Source: Stratalize competitive displacement composite. $0.10 USDC per call.
name: get_vendor_alternatives
